decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The upgrade-guide section [ev-00ae0ffe7ffa] sits under "Removed features". It names the subject (native patch-and-transform composition, i.e. Compositions using `spec.mode: Resources`), the change (deprecated in v1.17, removed in v2, replaced by composition functions) and who is exposed (Compositions with `spec.mode: Resources`). It also gives the required action: migrate to function pipelines before upgrading, using the `crossplane beta convert pipeline-composition` command. The validators refute P1's claim that the `spec.mode` field itself was removed: the field is still in the schema and only its default changed [ev-a3bca45d2477, ev-b12db1ba30d3]. That fits the removal of the `Resources` mode value rather than the field, so it affects how the change is typed, not whether the evidence is enough. The text does not say exactly what happens to an unmigrated Composition after the upgrade, but "migrate before upgrading" is enough to type the consequence as migration-required.
